filter_evaluation.caveat: filters designed after inspecting this sample => survivor shares are in-sample (optimistic) and the clean-pool estimates are not validated

results.note: Wilson intervals reflect sampling uncertainty only (simple random sample within stratum, no finite-population correction => slightly conservative). They do NOT capture systematic annotator error: the single annotator is an LLM (Claude Sonnet subagent) and no second annotator exists. 'overall' is an unweighted pooled rate over the stratified sample and is NOT a population estimate.

sampling.method: stratified by category; within category rank by sha256(seed NUL category NUL canonical_key), take first n_c

second_annotation.note: Agreement is between two LLM annotators and is NOT human validation. Wilson intervals on adjudicated labels reflect sampling uncertainty only.
